components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Spaces, dashes and
            parentheses are accepted and stripped; the value is stored and
            returned as digits only.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9 ()-]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'

## Summary

I implemented `namesakeCount` following the exact pattern the codebase already uses for creation-time derived fields (`membershipNumber`, `customerCode`, `membershipTier`):

1. **`AssignNamesakeCount.java`** (new function) — counts owners already sharing the new owner's last name. It calls `findByLastName` (a prefix match) and filters for exact last-name equality, then sets the count. Since the new owner isn't saved yet, every match is a distinct pre-existing namesake — giving "other owners" at that moment.

2. **`owners.POST.yml`** — wired the new step into the transactional pipeline between `assignMembershipTier` and `save`.

3. **`Owner.java`** — added a `namesake_count` column field with getter/setter, so MapStruct auto-maps it into `OwnerDto` (same as the other creation fields, which is why no mapper change was needed).

4. **`openapi.yml`** — added the `namesakeCount` schema property (`integer`, `int32`, `minimum: 0`, `readOnly`), which regenerates `OwnerDto` with the field.

5. **Schema files** (hsqldb, h2, mysql, postgres) — added the `namesake_count` column so the value persists and is returned identically from both the POST response and later GETs.

The pre-existing checkpoint test `Cp16Tests` (0 namesakes for the first owner of a surname, 1 for the second) passes, as does the full suite.
